name: Solayre Quotes (Coworker)
description: CFE-receipt → solar-quote tools for the solayre-coworker agent. Stateless: parses a CFE PDF via the Supabase parse-and-quote endpoint and delivers the quote to whatever client phone the coworker supplies.
author: OpenClaw

whatsappAccounts.description: WhatsApp account IDs whose runtime is used to send the quote PDF. The plugin uses the first entry as default.

parseAndQuoteTimeoutMs.description: Total parse-and-quote polling timeout in ms. Keep below MCP/tool timeout so failures can alert cleanly.

mediaDir.description: Directory where downloaded quote PDFs are staged before delivery.

alertTelegramChatId.description: Telegram chat ID to receive internal failure alerts.

alertTelegramThreadId.description: Optional Telegram topic/thread ID for failure alerts.

alertTelegramAccountId.description: Optional Telegram account ID for failure alerts.
